One day's investigation finished. Konatsu back with us. Time to compare findings.

In my room, of course. Boys in her room? Nahin. Tadayasu's house? Too grand; even entering felt like a small promotion. Tell him that and he'd only tilt his head. Kaisi grand? Perfectly normal house, to him.

Toh, my room. Democracy always came to my room.

en.html:
After meeting the woman with the stringed instrument and her elderly companion, the investigation had started moving almost too smoothly. Arre, this was actually working.

Before dusk, we had confirmed that Ritsu visited a few shops near the station, then set off home.

You ask a question, somebody knows the answer, you go to the next place. So that was how finding things worked. I had been prepared for a much larger contribution from suffering and guesswork. Those were the skills I had brought.

en.html:
Konatsu grimaced. Understandable.

As children, the four of us had considered that bamboo grove near Ritsu's house a perfect playground. We kept trying to get in. One difficulty: the owner kept trying to remain the owner. Old Tanaka.

The Thunder Emperor. Naam bhi, kaam bhi.

He allowed people to use the path through his grove. Even this much had required savage fighting with the neighbors: the First Thunder Emperor Disturbance. Passage was permitted. Playing? Bilkul nahin. Not one recreational breath.

His weapon was the Thunderclap. According to legend, ten wild dogs had received heart failure together. One shout, ten dogs. Economy of effort, absolute devastation of dog.

We had superior numbers. Scatter, attack from different directions, tire the old man out. Guerrilla warfare. Four children against one throat.

Then the neighbors intervened. Arre, what about us? Your war is entering our ears! We had no choice. Peace. Eight steamed sweet potatoes in exchange for withdrawal from every front. A peace treaty you could eat.

Thus ended the Second Thunder Emperor Disturbance.

Even now, that old man meant trouble. We had heard that age was keeping him quietly at home lately. Bhagwan ki kripa, we thought.

ja.html:
小夏が顔をしかめる。さもありなん。

　リツの家の近所の竹林は子供の頃のおれたち四人組
にとって絶好の遊びスポットだったから、幾度となく
侵入を試みた。

　そのたび立ちはだかったのが、竹林の所有者である
田中の爺さん。
　人呼んで雷帝。

　竹林を通行路として使われることは容認したものの
（そこへ至るにも付近住民との間で過酷な闘争があり、
これは第一次雷帝動乱と呼ばれる）、子供の遊び場に
されることは断固として認めなかった爺さんは、

　野犬一〇匹をまとめて心臓麻痺に至らしめたという
伝説の<ruby>雷鳴怒叫<rt>サンダークラップ</rt></ruby>を駆使して侵入者を攻撃。
　対するおれたちは兵力の優位を生かせる散開戦術を
選択。敵戦力の疲弊を狙ってゲリラ戦を繰り広げたが、

　付近住民の仲裁（雷鳴の流れ弾をくらうこっちの身
にもなれ）によりやむなく和睦。ふかし芋八個と引き
換えに全戦線から撤退したのだった。
　第二次雷帝動乱の終結である。

　そんなことがあったため、今でもあの爺さんはおれ
たちにとって鬼門だった。
　最近は寄る年波のせいか、家でおとなしくしている
ことが多くなったと聞いていたのだが。

Stand out, and people would talk. Bas, that was the arrangement.

I used to get angry. Ritsu herself went, 'Ohohoho, fame ka tax, I suppose,' so little by little I stopped minding.

Not getting a reaction made the gossips work even harder. Full effort, no salary.

en.html:
Konatsu stopped. Nobody took over.

Rokuhara's slave trade.

Probably a rumor with not one scrap of proof. Rokuhara se nafrat hai? Then you could think up that story. And find me one citizen who didn't hate Rokuhara. Of course it would spread.

Prejudice. Bas, people thinking the worst. Start with 'those bastards,' supply some terrible thing, and the mind would nod before you finished. Very convenient thinking. No evidence to carry, nothing heavy.

But even knowing that...

Rokuhara. Slave trade. Why did the words fit together so easily?

en.html:
At last, something like a way forward. Not a bright one. Haan, I could see that much too. But a way.

Ritsu hadn't come home today either.

The impatience kept growing. A friend you were used to having beside you. Bas, always there. How could her not being there hurt this much?

She had been taking up far more space than one person ought to. Now the space was empty, and somehow it was taking up even more. You couldn't look anywhere without noticing the idiot wasn't in it.

I could hardly stand it. Sleep also felt like time I should not be spending.

That night I slept, grown enormous in my dream, fighting a Dark Planet Person I had never met.

わかってる。
　わかっちゃいるけど。

　リツ……無事でいるよな？
　きっとどっかで遊んでるだけなんだろ？

　さっさと帰ってこいよ。
　今なら笑って許してやるから。

　それとも本当に、六波羅の鬼畜野郎にさらわれちま
ったのか。なら、おれは、
　おれは、

　糞。

　……おれはその夜、見も知らぬ暗闇星人と巨大化し
て戦う夢を見ながら眠った。
